notes: Aggregates current Form 1099-INT box-4 federal-withholding findings into the family subtotal, one of the four document subtotals Form 1040 line 25b adds (i1040gi-2025 l.2559-2576: 'Include on line 25b any federal income tax withheld on your Form(s) 1099-R ... include the amount withheld in the total on line 25b. This should be shown in box 4 of Form 1099'). Closed-empty publishes zero only through current literal-true closure. Published as its own rule so the explanation walk reaches this document (Track 1 contract item 2). Core v66 (itemization-cents, Track 4): this subtotal no longer rounds. It publishes the sum with cents; the line that adds it rounds the total once (i1040gi-2025 'Rounding Off to Whole Dollars': include cents when adding amounts and round off only the total). Its guards are unchanged.
